propositions: A single pathological pandoc input can hang the reconciler indefinitely because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, leaving spinning grandchildren alive.

The renderer must spawn pandoc with start_new_session=True and use caller-side communicate(input=unit_markdown, timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) with rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired to kill the whole process group.
Timeout configuration must be externalized as reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s (default 10s) across schema, environment, and documentation.
The pandoc binary from pypandoc-binary wheel must be pinned by exact version in pyproject.toml and verified in CI; the GPL licence must be recorded in a new repo-root NOTICE file.
Per-unit fallback behavior is unchanged: any unit timeout or non-zero exit degrades to original Markdown without raising, leaving all rendered output byte-identical to the landed renderer.

Batching of contiguous safe units was prototyped but descoped because it achieves only ~12% spawn reduction while changing output on ~12% of corpus bodies due to pandoc parsing block boundaries relative to surrounding content.
